text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — after rolling kernel-selector v2 to canary were seeing host CPU +9% p99 and p95 +6ms. Flame points to host-side parsing/streaming, not GPU.

Jin: perf snapshot I grabbed:
```
# perf top -p <pid>
 19.8% token_parser::parse_stream
 16.0% http2::hpack_encode
 14.2% small_frame_writer::emit
 10.5% kv_cache::rebind_shard
 6.7% grpc::writev
```

Alex: kv_cache::rebind_shard is telling — kernel placements are crossing KV shard boundaries and forcing more shard migrations. Also batching seems tiny for short seqs.

Lin: repro locally with 3k short-seq rps: with v2 mode avg write syscalls/request = 4.1 vs baseline 1.0. HPACK churn visible in tcpdump. KV shard occupancy stdev +12% during warmup.

Chris: action items: rollback on canary (temp), then run A/B: group B uses affinity-lock warmup + ingress coalescer (buffer small frames).

Maya: additional mitigation: bump short-seq batching watermark (8 -> 16 tokens) to reduce mini-batch churn and kernel switches.

Jin: uploaded flame + profile (high): https://perf.redwood/trace/2277/abcd. perf-bot created PERF-1251.

Alex: coalescer config I'd like to try: ingress.coalesce_small_frames=true, params: {max_frames:6, max_delay_ms:2, max_bytes:8192}. Should cut syscall/writev rate and HPACK ops.

Lin: i'll prototype ingress coalescer behind a flag. will add e2e test that asserts p95 does not regress >5% when coalescer enabled.

Chris: rolling rollback now. will monitor host cpu and kv-evict metrics.

perf-bot: [alert] Kernel-selector v2 on canary -> host CPU +9% p99, KV evict rate +7%. Trace ID: 2277000000. Suggested diffs: kernel affinity, batching thresholds, ingress frame coalesce.

Maya: assign owners: Alex (affinity + batching), Lin (ingress coalesce), Jin (flame + load tests), Chris (canary rollback + A/B). Schedule sync 2026-03-24 15:00 UTC. :calendar:

Alex: opening PR with config knobs and benchmark harness; will include microbench numbers for syscalls/writev and kv-hit during warmup.

Jin: uploading full flamegraph and pprof: https://perf.redwood/flame/2277/abcd. Will attach traces to PERF-1251.

Maya: thanks everyone. keep updates here. :thumbsup:
